literature.headline_zh: 汉坦病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期汉坦病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 该研究不报告任何临床结果或数据;这是一个假设生成的评论。 [10.1002/jca.70187]
对缺乏原钙粘蛋白-1 (PCDH1) 的人类细胞进行的基因研究表明,Necoclí、Tula 和 Nova 病毒利用 PCDH1 进行有效感染,尽管 Nova 表型较弱。除 Kenkeme 外,所有这些 Gn/Gc 蛋白均支持原代人内皮细胞的感染。 [10.1128/jvi.00994-26]
将上述两个物种的计算参数与之前研究的病毒的参数进行比较,根据它们对 ATG 分布变化的敏感性增加,按以下顺序排列:严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2、中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒、尼帕病毒、埃博拉病毒和登革热病毒,这与观察到和认识到的突变性非常一致。 [10.36922/gpd026270023]
针对其他病毒病原体的基于抗体的干预措施的证据证明了这种方法的临床可行性,并为其应用于 ANDV 提供了强有力的理由。 [10.1186/s40659-026-00724-8]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The study does not report any clinical results or data; it is a hypothesis-generating commentary. [10.1002/jca.70187]

Genetic studies in human cells lacking protocadherin-1 (PCDH1) showed that Necoclí, Tula, and Nova viruses use PCDH1 for efficient infection, although the Nova phenotype was weaker. All these Gn/Gc proteins except Kenkeme supported infection of primary human endothelial cells. [10.1128/jvi.00994-26]
The correction states that the ethical approval number was incorrectly stated as [SGWXH202308] and should be corrected to [202313]. [10.1186/s12879-026-14215-4]

These calculated parameters for the two species mentioned are compared with those of previously studied viruses, allowing them to be arranged in the following order based on their increasing sensitivity to variations in ATG distribution: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2, Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus, Nipah, Ebola, and dengue viruses, which is in good accordance with their observed and recognized mutability. [10.36922/gpd026270023]

Evidence from antibody-based interventions against other viral pathogens has demonstrated the clinical feasibility of this approach and provides a strong rationale for its application to ANDV. [10.1186/s40659-026-00724-8]

news.headline_zh: 汉坦病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期汉坦病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 英国卫生安全局证实,英国从日本获得了实验性法匹拉韦供应,以支持其汉坦病毒应对措施。该药物尚未在英国获得许可,但正在考虑用于治疗严重汉坦病毒感染的实验。 [news-bf1a121a20d1ca2a]
从一艘遭受汉坦病毒袭击的游轮上撤离的西班牙乘客已抵达马德里。该船停靠在特内里费岛海岸,西班牙当局、世界卫生组织(WHO)和邮轮公司Oceanwide Expeditions证实,目前船上没有乘客出现病毒症状。 [news-7794d04ad483a669]
据世界卫生组织 (WHO) 报告,与 MV Hondius 游轮疑似聚集性感染有关的汉坦病毒确诊病例已增至 5 例。世界卫生组织确认了这些病例,并表示暴发可能存在一些人际传播。该病毒类型被鉴定为Andes 汉坦病毒。 [news-a4c48042d3dc2787]
据世界卫生组织和医疗当局报告,MV Hondius 游轮上疑似 暴发 病毒导致三人死亡和数人患病。该事件被确认为 暴发 并造成相关死亡。 [news-d2c277cf013ffa83]
Physicians reported that media coverage of hantavirus outpaces actual risk, with 85% believing coverage is exaggerated and 77% rating population risk as low or non-meaningful. [news-6d7e715881f720ee]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Hantaviruses news developments.
key_findings_en: Britain received experimental favipiravir supplies from Japan to support its hantavirus response, as confirmed by the UK Health Security Agency. The drug is not licensed in the UK but is being considered for experimental use in treating severe hantavirus infections. [news-bf1a121a20d1ca2a]
Spanish passengers evacuated from a hantavirus-stricken cruise ship have arrived in Madrid. [news-7794d04ad483a669]

Confirmed hantavirus cases linked to a suspected cluster on the cruise ship MV Hondius have risen to five, as reported by the World Health Organization (WHO). The WHO confirmed the cases and stated that there may be some person-to-person spread in the outbreak. The type of virus was identified as Andes hantavirus. [news-a4c48042d3dc2787]

A suspected outbreak of hantavirus on the MV Hondius cruise ship resulted in three deaths and several illnesses, reported by the WHO and medical authorities. The event is confirmed as an outbreak with associated fatalities. [news-d2c277cf013ffa83]

Physicians reported that media coverage of hantavirus outpaces actual risk, with 85% believing coverage is exaggerated and 77% rating population risk as low or non-meaningful. A $2B telemedicine fraud scheme was also addressed, involving fraudulent prescriptions and sham visits. [news-6d7e715881f720ee]

据世界卫生组织和医疗当局报告,MV Hondius 游轮上疑似 暴发 病毒导致三人死亡和数人患病。该事件被确认为 暴发 并造成相关死亡。 [news-d2c277cf013ffa83]。

papers.title: Plasma Exchange for Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome: A Mechanistic Case for an Untested Intervention.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) carries a case fatality rate of 35%–40% and has no approved pharmacologic treatment. Its pathophysiology is rooted in the plasma compartment: cytokines, viral antigens, immune complexes, and platelet‐binding glycoproteins circulate as drivers of immunopathologic endothelial injury, noncardiogenic pulmonary edema, and cardiogenic depression. Therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) achieves bulk clearance of plasma‐borne mediators and is established by the American Society for Apheresis (ASFA) for numerous indications that share an analogous mechanistic rationale. This commentary argues that the immunopathology of HPS maps onto the therapeutic targets of TPE, that any intervention would need to be timed to the early cardiopulmonary phase, and that the coagulopathic dimension of the disease provides a mechanistic argument for incorporating plasma into the replacement strategy. We deliberately situate this rationale against the uneven record of TPE in diseases of comparable pathophysiology, in which the intervention has been effective in some settings and without demonstrable benefit in others. The recent Andes virus outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius, which produced a multinational cluster of severe cardiopulmonary cases, prompted us, as transfusion medicine and apheresis physicians, to articulate this hypothesis. We emphasize that these arguments are mechanistic and hypothesis‐generating rather than evidence‐based: no clinical data yet support TPE in HPS, and systematic outcome reporting, ideally through a multicenter case series, would be required before any conclusion about efficacy could be drawn.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) carries a case fatality rate of 35%–40% and has no approved pharmacologic treatment.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a commentary that outlines a mechanistic rationale for therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) in Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome, focusing on the disease's pathophysiology and the potential therapeutic targets of TPE.
analysis.methods: The authors present a theoretical framework based on the known pathophysiology of HPS and the established use of TPE in other conditions with similar mechanistic underpinnings.
analysis.main_results: The study does not report any clinical results or data; it is a hypothesis-generating commentary.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors argue that the immunopathology of HPS aligns with the therapeutic targets of TPE and that the coagulopathic dimension of the disease provides a mechanistic argument for incorporating plasma into the replacement strategy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that TPE could be a potential therapeutic strategy for HPS, warranting further investigation through systematic outcome reporting and multicenter case series.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The arguments are mechanistic and hypothesis-generating rather than evidence-based, as no clinical data yet support TPE in HPS.

analysis.summary_en: This commentary presents a mechanistic rationale for therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) in Hantavirus Pulmonary Syndrome (HPS), a severe disease with a high case fatality rate and no approved pharmacologic treatment. The authors argue that TPE's targets align with the immunopathology of HPS, particularly its coagulopathic features, and that the recent Andes virus outbreak prompted this hypothesis. However, the study is not evidence-based and emphasizes the need for systematic outcome reporting before any conclusion about efficacy can be drawn. The findings suggest that TPE may be a potential intervention for HPS, but further research is required to validate this hypothesis. The study highlights the importance of understanding the disease's pathophysiology to guide future clinical trials and treatment strategies.

papers.title_zh: 汉坦病毒肺综合征 的血浆交换:未经测试的干预的机制案例。
papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) carries a case fatality rate of 35%–40% and has no approved pharmacologic treatment. Its pathophysiology is rooted in the plasma compartment: cytokines, viral antigens, immune complexes, and platelet‐binding glycoproteins circulate as drivers of immunopathologic endothelial injury, noncardiogenic pulmonary edema, and cardiogenic depression. Therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) achieves bulk clearance of plasma‐borne mediators and is established by the American Society for Apheresis (ASFA) for numerous indications that share an analogous mechanistic rationale. This commentary argues that the immunopathology of HPS maps onto the therapeutic targets of TPE, that any intervention would need to be timed to the early cardiopulmonary phase, and that the coagulopathic dimension of the disease provides a mechanistic argument for incorporating plasma into the replacement strategy. We deliberately situate this rationale against the uneven record of TPE in diseases of comparable pathophysiology, in which the intervention has been effective in some settings and without demonstrable benefit in others. The recent Andes virus outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius, which produced a multinational cluster of severe cardiopulmonary cases, prompted us, as transfusion medicine and apheresis physicians, to articulate this hypothesis. We emphasize that these arguments are mechanistic and hypothesis‐generating rather than evidence‐based: no clinical data yet support TPE in HPS, and systematic outcome reporting, ideally through a multicenter case series, would be required before any conclusion about efficacy could be drawn.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 汉坦病毒肺综合征 (HPS) 的病死率为 35%–40%,且尚未获得批准的药理学 治疗。其病理生理学根源于血浆室:细胞因子、病毒抗原、免疫复合物和血小板结合糖蛋白作为免疫病理性内皮损伤、非心源性肺水肿和心源性抑郁的驱动因素而循环。治疗性血浆置换 (TPE) 可实现血浆介质介质的大量清除,由美国血浆置换协会 (ASFA) 建立,用于具有类似机制原理的众多适应症。该评论认为,HPS 的免疫病理学映射到 TPE 的治疗靶点,任何干预都需要在早期心肺期进行,并且该疾病的凝血病维度为将血浆纳入替代策略提供了机制论据。我们特意将这一基本原理与类似病理生理学疾病中 TPE 的不均匀记录进行对比,在这些疾病中,干预措施在某些情况下有效,但在其他情况下没有明显的益处。最近,MV Hondius 号游轮上出现的安第斯山脉病毒 暴发 造成了多国严重心肺病例,促使我们作为输血医学和单采医生阐明了这一假设。我们强调,这些论点是机械论和假设生成的,而不是基于证据的:尚无临床数据支持 HPS 中的 TPE,并且在得出任何关于疗效的结论之前,需要系统的结果报告(最好是通过多中心病例系列)。

papers.title: Antibody-based therapies against Andes virus: from neutralization to Fc-mediated protection
papers.abstract: Abstract Andes virus, the principal etiological agent of hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in South America, is a zoonotic pathogen associated with case fatality rates of up to 40%. Despite its high clinical burden and unique capacity for person-to-person transmission among hantaviruses, no licensed vaccines or specific antiviral therapies are currently available. These limitations underscore the need to develop effective therapeutic and prophylactic strategies against ANDV. Monoclonal antibodies have emerged as a promising platform for the prevention and treatment of viral diseases because of their high specificity, rapid development, and potential for optimization through antibody engineering. While virus neutralization remains a key mechanism of protection, Fc-mediated effector functions, including antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity, antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and antibody-dependent complement deposition, have increasingly been recognized as critical contributors to antiviral immunity and therapeutic efficacy. Evidence from antibody-based interventions against other viral pathogens has demonstrated the clinical feasibility of this approach and provides a strong rationale for its application to ANDV. In this review, we summarize current advances in antibody-based therapies targeting ANDV, discuss the contribution of Fc-mediated effector functions to antiviral protection, and highlight emerging strategies to optimize antibody engineering for the development of more effective therapeutic and prophylactic interventions against this neglected pathogen.

papers.title_zh: 针对安第斯病毒的抗体疗法:从中和到 Fc 介导的保护
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Andes virus, the principal etiological agent of hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in South America, is a zoonotic pathogen associated with case fatality rates of up to 40%. Despite its high clinical burden and unique capacity for person-to-person transmission among hantaviruses, no licensed vaccines or specific antiviral therapies are currently available. These limitations underscore the need to develop effective therapeutic and prophylactic strategies against ANDV. Monoclonal antibodies have emerged as a promising platform for the prevention and treatment of viral diseases because of their high specificity, rapid development, and potential for optimization through antibody engineering. While virus neutralization remains a key mechanism of protection, Fc-mediated effector functions, including antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity, antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis, and antibody-dependent complement deposition, have increasingly been recognized as critical contributors to antiviral immunity and therapeutic efficacy. Evidence from antibody-based interventions against other viral pathogens has demonstrated the clinical feasibility of this approach and provides a strong rationale for its application to ANDV. In this review, we summarize current advances in antibody-based therapies targeting ANDV, discuss the contribution of Fc-mediated effector functions to antiviral protection, and highlight emerging strategies to optimize antibody engineering for the development of more effective therapeutic and prophylactic interventions against this neglected pathogen.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 安第斯病毒是南美洲汉坦病毒心肺综合征的主要病原体,是一种人畜共患病原体,病死率高达 40%。尽管汉坦病毒中的临床负担较高且具有独特的人对人传播能力,但目前尚无获得许可的疫苗或特定的抗病毒药物疗法。这些限制强调需要制定针对 ANDV 的有效治疗和预防策略。单克隆抗体因其高特异性、快速开发以及通过抗体工程优化的潜力而成为预防和病毒性疾病的有前景的平台。虽然病毒中和仍然是关键的保护机制,但 Fc 介导的效应功能,包括抗体依赖性细胞毒性、抗体依赖性细胞吞噬作用和抗体依赖性补体沉积,已越来越多地被认为是 抗病毒药物 免疫和治疗功效的关键贡献者。针对其他病毒病原体的基于抗体的干预措施的证据证明了这种方法的临床可行性,并为其应用于 ANDV 提供了强有力的理由。在这篇综述中,我们总结了针对 ANDV 的基于抗体的疗法的当前进展,讨论了 Fc 介导的效应器功能对 抗病毒药物 保护的贡献,并重点介绍了优化抗体工程的新兴策略,以针对这种被忽视的病原体开发更有效的治疗和预防干预措施。

papers.title: Expanded protocadherin-1 usage reveals a broader hantavirus entry landscape.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Mammalian hantaviruses are RNA viruses that cause hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in the Americas and hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome in Eurasia. The cellular entry mechanisms of most hantaviruses remain poorly defined. To examine entry by phylogenetically distinct hantaviruses identified across Africa, Eurasia, and the Americas, we generated replication-competent recombinant vesicular stomatitis viruses (rVSVs) bearing Gn/Gc proteins from Necoclí, Sangassou, Thottapalayam, Kenkeme, Nova, Oxbow, and Tula viruses. All these Gn/Gc proteins except Kenkeme supported infection of primary human endothelial cells, indicating that endothelial cell entry is permissive for a broader range of hantaviruses than previously appreciated. Except for rVSV-Kenkeme, these rVSVs did not acquire additional mutations beyond pre-engineered rescue-enhancing changes during rescue and passaging. Genetic studies in human cells lacking protocadherin-1 (PCDH1) showed that Necoclí, Tula, and Nova viruses use PCDH1 for efficient infection, although the Nova phenotype was weaker. These three Gn/Gc proteins bound soluble PCDH1 with different apparent avidities, and infection by the corresponding rVSVs was inhibited by soluble PCDH1; Necoclí and Tula, but not Nova, were also blocked by a PCDH1-targeting monoclonal antibody. Authentic Tula virus infection was similarly reduced in PCDH1 knockout endothelial cells. Finally, the broadly reactive anti-Gn/Gc human monoclonal antibody ADI-42898 efficiently neutralized Necoclí, Nova, Sangassou, and Kenkeme rVSVs, but showed weak or undetectable activity against Oxbow, Tula, and Thottapalayam rVSVs. Together, these findings expand the range of hantavirus glycoproteins capable of mediating infection of human endothelial cells, broaden the phylogenetic scope of PCDH1-dependent entry, and identify receptor-targeted and viral glycoprotein-targeted strategies with differential activity. IMPORTANCE Many newly discovered hantaviruses are known only from sequence data, leaving their ability to enter human cells and their receptor usage unresolved. Using a BSL2-compatible recombinant vesicular stomatitis virus (rVSV) system, we show that glycoproteins from several divergent hantaviruses can mediate infection of primary human endothelial cells, indicating that endothelial cell entry is permissive for a broader range of hantaviruses than previously appreciated. We also show that protocadherin-1 (PCDH1), previously linked mainly to New World hantaviruses, is used by Necoclí, Tula, and Nova viruses but not universally across the panel, revealing broader but heterogeneous receptor usage. An authentic Tula virus experiment supports this conclusion beyond the surrogate system. Finally, a broadly reactive anti-Gn/Gc antibody neutralizes several, but not all, of these viruses, highlighting both the promise and the limits of broadly protective countermeasures and the utility of these rVSVs for evaluating entry inhibitors.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 哺乳动物汉坦病毒是一种 RNA 病毒,在美洲引起汉坦病毒心肺综合征,在欧亚大陆引起 肾综合征出血热。大多数汉坦病毒的细胞进入机制仍然不明确。为了检查在非洲、欧亚大陆和美洲发现的系统发育上不同的汉坦病毒的条目,我们生成了具有复制能力的重组水泡性口炎病毒 (rVSV),其带有 Necoclí、Sangassou、Thottapalayam、Kenkeme、Nova、Oxbow 和 Tula 病毒的 Gn/Gc 蛋白。除 Kenkeme 外,所有这些 Gn/Gc 蛋白均支持原代人内皮细胞的感染,表明内皮细胞进入允许的汉坦病毒范围比之前认识的更广泛。除了 rVSV-Kenkeme 之外,这些 rVSV 在救援和传代过程中除了预先设计的救援增强变化外,没有获得额外的 突变。对缺乏原钙粘蛋白-1 (PCDH1) 的人类细胞进行的基因研究表明,Necoclí、Tula 和 Nova 病毒利用 PCDH1 进行有效感染,尽管 Nova 表型较弱。这三种Gn/Gc蛋白以不同的表观亲合力结合可溶性PCDH1,并且可溶性PCDH1抑制相应rVSV的感染;Necoclí 和 Tula(但不是 Nova)也被 PCDH1 靶向单克隆抗体阻断。在 PCDH1 敲除的内皮细胞中,真正的图拉病毒感染也同样减少。最后,具有广泛反应性的抗 Gn/Gc 人单克隆抗体 ADI-42898 可有效中和 Necoclí、Nova、Sangassou 和 Kenkeme rVSV,但对 Oxbow、Tula 和 Thottapalayam rVSV 的活性较弱或无法检测到。总之,这些发现扩大了能够介导人内皮细胞感染的汉坦病毒糖蛋白的范围,扩大了 PCDH1 依赖性进入的系统发育范围,并确定了具有不同活性的受体靶向和病毒糖蛋白靶向策略。重要性 许多新发现的汉坦病毒只能从序列数据中得知,因此它们进入人体细胞的能力及其受体的使用尚未解决。使用 BSL2 兼容的重组水泡性口炎病毒 (rVSV) 系统,我们发现来自几种不同汉坦病毒的糖蛋白可以介导原代人内皮细胞的感染,这表明内皮细胞进入的许可范围比之前预期的更广泛。我们还表明,原钙粘蛋白-1 (PCDH1) 以前主要与新世界汉坦病毒有关,被 Necoclí、Tula 和 Nova 病毒使用,但在整个组中并不普遍,揭示了更广泛但异质的受体使用。真实的图拉病毒实验在替代系统之外支持了这一结论。最后,一种具有广泛反应性的抗 Gn/Gc 抗体可以中和其中几种病毒,但不是全部,这凸显了广泛保护性对策的前景和局限性,以及这些 rVSV 在评估进入抑制剂方面的效用。

analysis_zh.main_results: 对缺乏原钙粘蛋白-1 (PCDH1) 的人类细胞进行的基因研究表明,Necoclí、Tula 和 Nova 病毒利用 PCDH1 进行有效感染,尽管 Nova 表型较弱。除 Kenkeme 外,所有这些 Gn/Gc 蛋白均支持原代人内皮细胞的感染。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现扩大了能够介导人内皮细胞感染的汉坦病毒糖蛋白的范围,并揭示了更广泛但异质的受体用途,强调了广泛保护性对策的前景和局限性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果提供了对汉坦病毒受体使用的深入了解,这可以为靶向治疗的开发提供信息,并提高对汉坦病毒进入机制的理解,从而更好地制定 监测 和预防策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究使用了替代系统和真实的图拉病毒实验,但结果可能无法完全代表所有汉坦病毒,并且由于测试病毒范围有限,证据不充分。

papers.title: Hantavirus Research in Africa: Human Serological Evidence, Host-Associated Virus Diversity, and Surveillance Gaps
papers.abstract: Hantavirus research in Africa has expanded from isolated serological observations to molecular detection of viruses in rodent, shrew, and bat hosts. This concise narrative review summarizes evidence for human serological exposure, host-associated virus diversity, genomic characterization, and public-health relevance. Human serological evidence compatible with hantavirus exposure has been reported in Guinea, Côte d’Ivoire, Gabon, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Madagascar, Mozambique, and Uganda. The strongest African human evidence consists of serological findings compatible with exposure: Sangassou-virus-compatible antibodies in febrile Guinean patients and Bowé-virus-specific IgM in a Côte d’Ivoire patient with fever and renal failure; however, viral RNA has not been recovered from an African patient specimen. Molecular studies have identified Sangassou virus in African wood mice, Seoul orthohantavirus in Senegalese black rats, and diverse shrew- and bat-associated lineages across West, Central, and East Africa. These findings demonstrate substantial viral diversity and human exposure, but do not establish that most newly detected viruses cause human disease. The 2026 Andes orthohantavirus outbreak associated with the cruise ship Hondius—13 cases and three deaths—illustrates the importance of imported-infection preparedness rather than African transmission. Africa’s central research gap is the absence of integrated surveillance linking unexplained febrile illness, validated serology, molecular confirmation, host sampling, and complete viral genomes.

analysis.summary_en: This review highlights the expansion of hantavirus research in Africa, emphasizing human serological exposure and host-associated virus diversity. It reports serological evidence compatible with hantavirus exposure in several African countries, including Guinea and Côte d’Ivoire, and identifies molecularly characterized viruses in rodent, shrew, and bat hosts. Despite these findings, the review notes that viral RNA has not been recovered from any African patient specimen, and it underscores the lack of integrated surveillance to link unexplained febrile illness with hantavirus. The review also references the 2026 Andes orthohantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship, illustrating the need for preparedness against imported infections. The central research gap is the absence of comprehensive surveillance systems that combine serological, molecular, and host data to better understand hantavirus epidemiology and public health relevance in Africa.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这篇简明的叙述性综述总结了人类血清学暴露、宿主 相关病毒多样性、基因组特征和公共卫生相关性的证据。该审查没有明确报告荟萃分析或共识过程,但它是基于来自非洲各个国家的分子研究和血清学发现。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 几内亚、科特迪瓦、加蓬、刚果民主共和国、马达加斯加、莫桑比克和乌干达报告了与汉坦病毒暴露相符的人类血清学证据。分子研究已经在非洲林鼠中发现了桑加苏病毒,在塞内加尔黑鼠中发现了首尔正汉坦病毒,以及西非、中非和东非的多种与鼩鼱和蝙蝠相关的谱系。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 最强有力的非洲人类证据包括与暴露相符的血清学结果:几内亚发热患者中的桑加苏病毒相容性抗体以及科特迪瓦发烧和肾功能衰竭患者中的​​鲍韦病毒特异性 IgM;然而,尚未从非洲患者样本中回收到病毒 RNA。这些发现证明了巨大的病毒多样性和人类接触情况,但并未证实大多数新发现的病毒会导致人类疾病。

papers.title: Andes virus and person-to-person transmission: a critical One Health review
papers.abstract: Andes orthohantavirus (ANDV) is a rodent-borne, tri-segmented, negative-sense RNA virus that causes hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome in southern South America. Most infections follow exposure to dust, surfaces, or particles contaminated with urine, faeces, or saliva from infected reservoir rodents. ANDV is unusual among hantaviruses because limited person-to-person transmission has been reported in Argentina and Chile. This critical narrative review evaluates ANDV taxonomy, genetic diversity, reservoir ecology, patient shedding, outbreak epidemiology, transmission mechanisms, and countermeasures from a One Health perspective. The evidence supports a narrow conclusion: ANDV can spread between people, especially after close, prolonged, household, caregiving, nosocomial, or intimate exposure. Recent studies showing viral RNA, and sometimes infectious virus, in blood, oral, nasopharyngeal, urine, and other compartments strengthen the biological plausibility of close-contact transmission. However, RNA detection, body-fluid infectivity, similar viral genomes, and co-housing animal transmission do not by themselves show routine casual airborne spread. Most disease still follows rodent-associated environmental exposure, and shared environmental exposure remains a major confounder in endemic areas. ANDV should not be described as non-transmissible between humans, but it should also not be framed as an efficient airborne respiratory virus. Preparedness should combine rodent-exposure reduction, early clinical recognition, isolation and body-fluid precautions for suspected cases, contact monitoring, paired human-rodent sequencing, updated serosurveys, and continued development of vaccines, antibody-based therapies, and early antivirals.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review focuses on Andes virus (ANDV) and its potential for person-to-person transmission, particularly in the context of hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) in southern South America. The central question is whether ANDV can spread between humans through close contact, and how this compares to other hantaviruses.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a critical narrative synthesis of existing literature on ANDV, including its taxonomy, genetic diversity, reservoir ecology, patient shedding, outbreak epidemiology, transmission mechanisms, and countermeasures. analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that ANDV can spread between people, particularly through close, prolonged, household, caregiving, nosocomial, or intimate exposure. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that preparedness should include rodent-exposure reduction, early clinical recognition, isolation and body-fluid precautions for suspected cases, contact monitoring, paired human-rodent sequencing, updated serosurveys, and continued development of vaccines, antibody-based therapies, and early antivirals.

analysis.summary_en: This critical narrative review examines Andes virus (ANDV) and its potential for person-to-person transmission, focusing on hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) in southern South America. The review highlights that while limited human-to-human transmission has been reported, most infections still occur through rodent-associated environmental exposure. It underscores the importance of understanding ANDV's unique transmission dynamics and emphasizes the need for integrated One Health approaches to mitigate risks. The review also identifies gaps in evidence, particularly regarding the extent of airborne transmission and the role of shared environments in confounding results. Implications for research and practice include reducing rodent exposure, improving early detection, and advancing therapeutic options.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 ANDV 现有文献的批判性叙述综合,包括其分类、遗传多样性、储存宿主 生态学、患者脱落、暴发 流行病学、传播 机制和对策。证据来自对 ANDV 和相关汉坦病毒的研究,以“同一个健康”的观点强调人类、动物和环境因素之间的相互作用。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,ANDV 可以在人与人之间传播,特别是通过近距离、长期、家庭、护理、医院或亲密接触。然而,它强调,这种 传播 是有限的,不是常规的,大多数感染仍然是由啮齿动物相关的环境暴露引起的。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于人体体液中病毒 RNA 或传染性病毒的存在是否表明存在常规空气传播 传播 存在争议。该审查强调,RNA 检测和类似病毒 基因组 并不能证实偶然的空气传播。此外,共同的环境暴露仍然是流行地区的一个主要混杂因素,限制了隔离人与人之间 传播 效应的能力。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注安第斯病毒 (ANDV) 及其人传人 传播 的潜力,特别是在南美洲南部汉坦病毒心肺综合征 (HCPS) 的背景下。核心问题是 ANDV 是否可以通过密切接触在人与人之间传播,以及这与其他汉坦病毒相比如何。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 ANDV 现有文献的批判性叙述综合,包括其分类、遗传多样性、储存宿主 生态学、患者脱落、暴发 流行病学、传播 机制和对策。证据来自对 ANDV 和相关汉坦病毒的研究,以“同一个健康”的观点强调人类、动物和环境因素之间的相互作用。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,ANDV 可以在人与人之间传播,特别是通过近距离、长期、家庭、护理、医院或亲密接触。然而,它强调,这种 传播 是有限的,不是常规的,大多数感染仍然是由啮齿动物相关的环境暴露引起的。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于人体体液中病毒 RNA 或传染性病毒的存在是否表明存在常规空气传播 传播 存在争议。该审查强调,RNA 检测和类似病毒 基因组 并不能证实偶然的空气传播。此外,共同的环境暴露仍然是流行地区的一个主要混杂因素,限制了隔离人与人之间 传播 效应的能力。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查建议,准备工作应包括减少啮齿动物暴露、早期临床识别、疑似病例的隔离和体液预防措施、接触监测、人-啮齿动物配对测序、更新血清调查以及继续开发 疫苗、基于抗体的疗法和早期 抗病毒药物。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand why the WHO declared the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the Congo a global emergency but not the hantavirus cruise ship outbreak. This is important because it highlights the criteria used by the WHO to determine the international concern status of outbreaks.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study compared the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the Congo with the hantavirus cruise ship outbreak, analyzing their transmission dynamics, epidemic potential, impact on travel and trade, and geopolitical factors. The analysis focused on these two specific outbreaks.
analysis.methods: The study used a comparative analysis of the two outbreaks, examining factors such as transmission dynamics, epidemic potential, impact on travel and trade, and geopolitical considerations. These factors were evaluated to determine the WHO's decision-making process for declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
analysis.main_results: The study found that the Ebola outbreak in the Congo had higher transmission potential, greater impact on travel and trade, and more significant geopolitical implications compared to the hantavirus cruise ship outbreak. These differences influenced the WHO's decision to declare the Ebola outbreak as a global emergency.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the WHO's decision was based on the relative severity and spread of the outbreaks, emphasizing the importance of transmission dynamics and global impact in the declaration process. This provides a novel framework for understanding the criteria used in such declarations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform future surveillance and response strategies by highlighting the factors that influence WHO's decision to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. This is particularly relevant for managing outbreaks of hantaviruses and other emerging pathogens.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported WHO decisions and available outbreak data, which may not capture all nuances of the decision-making process. The evidence is moderate, as it is based on comparative analysis rather than direct empirical data.

analysis.summary_en: This study compares the 2026 Ebola outbreak in the Congo with the hantavirus cruise ship outbreak to understand why the WHO declared the former a global emergency but not the latter. It identifies key factors such as transmission dynamics, epidemic potential, impact on travel and trade, and geopolitical considerations that influence the WHO's decision-making process. The findings suggest that these factors are critical in determining the international concern status of outbreaks. The study provides a framework for evaluating future outbreaks and highlights the importance of these criteria in public health responses. However, the study is limited by its reliance on reported decisions and available data, which may not fully capture the complexity of the WHO's assessment. The evidence is considered moderate due to the nature of the comparative analysis.

papers.title: Geometrical study of DNA sequences of New World hantavirus and Nipah virus using the ATG genomic walk method
papers.abstract: Viral genome analysis is essential for characterizing genetic variation and evolutionary patterns, while complementary computational approaches may provide additional insights beyond conventional sequence-based methods. In this paper, the complete RNAs of New World hantavirus and Nipah virus are analyzed using a DNA walk method that traces the distribution of ATG triplets along sequences. It provides visual one-dimensional models (ATG trajectories) of genomes on a plane and quantitative estimates based on: (i) point-defined relative values of the divergence of ATG trajectories, (ii) relative global-defined standard deviation of ATG triplet numbers in a studied set of sequences, and (iii) relative global-defined standard deviation of fractal dimension values of inter-ATG distances in the same sequence set. These calculated parameters for the two species mentioned are compared with those of previously studied viruses, allowing them to be arranged in the following order based on their increasing sensitivity to variations in ATG distribution: Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2, Middle East Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus, Nipah, Ebola, and dengue viruses, which is in good accordance with their observed and recognized mutability. The method verified in this paper can be used as a supplementary pre-screening qualitative and quantitative tool for conventional sequencing analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces the ATG genomic walk method as a novel computational approach for analyzing viral DNA sequences, specifically applied to New World hantavirus and Nipah virus. The method generates visual one-dimensional models and quantitative estimates of ATG triplet distribution, which are compared with other viruses to assess sensitivity to genetic variation. The authors interpret these findings as providing a new perspective on viral mutability, with implications for improving surveillance and diagnostic methods. The study's results are in line with the observed mutability of the compared viruses, but the evidence is limited to a single method and lacks direct experimental validation. The findings are considered moderate in strength due to these constraints.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在本文中,使用 DNA walk 方法分析了新世界汉坦病毒和尼帕病毒的完整 RNA,该方法追踪 ATG 三联体沿序列的分布。

elements_zh.main_results: 将上述两个物种的计算参数与之前研究的病毒的参数进行比较,根据它们对 ATG 分布变化的敏感性增加,按以下顺序排列:严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2、中东呼吸综合征冠状病毒、尼帕病毒、埃博拉病毒和登革热病毒,这与观察到和认识到的突变性非常一致。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能有助于开发更灵敏的方法来检测和分析汉坦病毒和其他相关病毒的遗传变异,从而有可能提高 监测 和诊断能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其只关注单一方法以及与之前研究的病毒进行比较,这可能无法完全捕捉到汉坦病毒遗传变异的复杂性。证据是中等的。

papers.title: Epidemiology and economic burden of Puumala virus infection in Styria, Austria, 2003 to 2024
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hantavirus infections cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome and impose a potential burden on healthcare systems. However, comprehensive economic data remain scarce. We quantified the inpatient economic burden of hospitalized patients with Puumala virus (PUUV) infections in Styria, Austria ́s primary endemic region, to identify hospitalization costs and early admission predictors of costs. Methods This retrospective cost-of-illness study analyzed 1,049 serologically confirmed PUUV hospitalizations across 20 public hospitals in Styria, Austria between September 2003 and March 2024. Costs were estimated using the Austrian performance-oriented hospital financing (LKF) diagnosis-related-group-system, standardized to 2024-equivalent Euros using consumer-price-index deflation. Admission predictors of cost were assessed using multivariable γ-generalized-linear-modeling with multiple imputation. Temporal trends in length of stay were analyzed using weighted segmented linear regression. Results Cumulative inpatient cost was approximately €10.3 million (mean per-case: €9,788) for the entire study period of 21 years. Three epidemic years (2012, 2019, 2021) accounted for 53.6% of cases and over €5.2 million in expenditure, with peak annual costs reaching €1.93 million (0.274% of total Styrian inpatient expenditure) in 2012. Prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time (aPTT; cost-ratio 1.024 per second, 95% CI 1.019–1.030) and older age (CR 1.004 per year, 95%-CI 1.001–1.008) were independent admission-level predictors of higher cost. Median hospital length of stay declined by approximately 50% over the study period. Conclusions PUUV hospitalizations impose a sharply episodic but recurrent economic burden on regional healthcare systems. Admission aPTT and age independently predicted cost, but clinical outcomes were not modelled and these variables do not constitute a triage tool. Epidemic preparedness strategies are warranted.

papers.title: Explainable Multi-View Machine Learning for Hantavirus Detection and Severity Classification Using Synthetic Data: A Computational Benchmark and Data-Integrity Assessment
papers.abstract: This study presents an explainable multi-view machine-learning framework for hantavirus detection and diseaseseverity classification using structured synthetic clinical and laboratory data. A public benchmark comprising 10,000 entirely synthetic records was evaluated under clinical-only, laboratory-only, and decision-level fusion settings. A genetic algorithm (GA) was used for task- and classifier-specific feature selection, and six machine-learning classifiers were evaluated using a stratified 80:20 development–test protocol. Clinical and laboratory probabilities were integrated through 10,000 Monte Carlo weight samples evaluated using out-of-fold development predictions.
papers.journal: International Journal of Innovative Science and Research Technology

papers.title: Хантавірусна інфекція: епідеміологія, шляхи передачі, сучасні підходи до лікування, ситуація в Україні та Європі Hantavirus infection: epidemiology, transmission routes, current treatment approaches, and the situation in Ukraine and Europe
papers.abstract: Хантавірусна інфекція залишається актуальною проблемою для країн Європи та України попри відносно невисоку загальну захворюваність. У країнах Європи переважають форми які асоційовані з геморагічною гарячкою та нирковим синдромом, спричинені вірусом Puumala, рідше – Dobrava, Seoul та Tula. За даними ECDC, у 2023 р. у 28 країнах ЄС/ЄЕЗ зареєстровано 1885 випадків, причому найвищі показники відзначалися у Фінляндії та Німеччині – 60,5% усіх повідомлених випадків. Дані літературних джерел свідчать, що в Європі серопревалентність хантавірусної інфекції в загальній популяції становить близько 2,98%, а в групах професійного ризику – є вищою.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the ongoing relevance of hantavirus infection in Europe and Ukraine, despite relatively low overall prevalence. It highlights that in European countries, the predominant forms of the infection are associated with hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS), caused primarily by Puumala virus, with less frequent involvement of Dobrava, Seoul, and Tula viruses. The research underscores the importance of understanding the seroprevalence of hantavirus infection, particularly among high-risk groups, and emphasizes the need for targeted surveillance and prevention strategies. The findings suggest that while the data are based on literature sources, they provide a general picture of the infection's spread and highlight the necessity for further investigation into its epidemiology and public health implications.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on mammalian orthohantaviruses associated with human disease and their specific syndromes. The central question is to evaluate current advances, challenges, and future perspectives in omics approaches for hantavirus research.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is an erratum to the original publication, which was a comprehensive analysis of omics approaches in hantavirus research. It does not report new evidence but corrects previous information. The review method is not explicitly detailed, but it is based on the original full-text evidence.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights the importance of omics technologies in understanding hantavirus biology, pathogenesis, and host interactions. It emphasizes the need for integrating multi-omics data to improve diagnostic accuracy and therapeutic strategies.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that while omics approaches have advanced significantly, there are still gaps in understanding the molecular mechanisms of hantavirus-induced diseases. Additionally, the review identifies limitations in the availability of comprehensive genomic data for certain hantavirus strains.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that future research should focus on expanding genomic and proteomic databases for hantaviruses, particularly for strains with limited data. It also recommends the development of standardized protocols for omics-based studies to enhance reproducibility and comparability across research groups.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides an erratum to the original article on omics approaches in hantavirus research, emphasizing the importance of integrating multi-omics data to improve understanding of hantavirus biology and disease mechanisms. It highlights current advances, challenges, and future research directions, particularly in expanding genomic databases and developing standardized protocols. The review identifies gaps in molecular mechanisms and data availability for certain hantavirus strains, suggesting the need for further investigation to enhance diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

papers.title: Open ecological, genomic and digital behavioural data resolve the 2026 MV Hondius Andes virus outbreak to the southern-Andean reservoir zone
papers.abstract: The 2026 Andes virus (ANDV) outbreak aboard the MV Hondius cruise ship resulted in 11 confirmed cases and 3 deaths and raised questions regarding the origin of infection, with much media focus resting on a landfill in Tierra del Fuego. We evaluated competing exposure hypotheses by assembling open data on reservoir host occurrences, rodent serosurveys, and historical ANDV outbreaks along with the index cases self-documented, publicly-posted citizen-science digital record of their movements. Historical outbreaks associated with human-to-human transmission were concentrated within a restricted region spanning southern Chile and adjacent western Argentina, coinciding with the distribution of the principal reservoir host, Oligoryzomys longicaudatus, and areas identified as elevated risk by multiple ecological and genetic models. The index case was documented within this transmission focus shortly before the putative exposure period. Together, our open data approach was able to rapidly locate initial exposure within the established ANDV transmission focus and develop scenarios to prioritise further epidemiological investigation.

papers.title: Perspectives for pharmaceutical screening at XFEL sources using the example of Lassa virus endonuclease.
papers.abstract: Emerging human pathogenic RNA viruses such as Lassa virus (LASV) and closely related viruses such as Hantavirus and Andes virus continue to be a major health threat globally. Treatment options for infections are severely limited. The widely conserved cap-snatching endonuclease of LASV (LASVendoN) is therefore used as an interesting drug target for our X-ray compound-screening experiments. Considering recent improvements in instrumentation and serial crystallography method development, different approaches may be used to facilitate pharmaceutical compound screening. Current-generation X-ray free-electron laser (XFEL) sources hold promise for obtaining higher quality diffraction data and achieving a high sample throughput using fixed-target serial femtosecond X-ray crystallography. We collected serial fixed-target X-ray diffraction data at Linac Coherent Light Source and at the synchrotron source PETRA III for comparison and solved the crystal structures of 2,4-dioxo-4-phenylbutanoic acid (DPBA) and baloxavir acid (BXA) binding to the active site of LASVendoN. These solved structures represent a reasonable starting point for drug development. In addition to room-temperature diffraction data, conventional single-crystal diffraction data were recorded at 100 K for comparison. To analyse the sample throughput in a compound-screening experiment at an XFEL, we further present data for the bacterial fosfomycin-resistance protein A with six ligands previously identified in a synchrotron screening experiment. In summary, the XFEL and synchrotron data-collection approaches have proven to be useful for compound screening with minor differences in achievable data quality and resolution. The individual experimental setup, detector and potentially the use of beam sweeping at XFELs at close-to-physiological temperatures combined with reasonable sample consumption and minimized radiation damage are considered to be advantageous for high-throughput drug development.
papers.journal: Acta crystallographica. Section D, Structural biology

papers.title_zh: 以拉沙病毒核酸内切酶为例,对 XFEL 来源的药物筛选进行展望。
papers.source_body_en: Emerging human pathogenic RNA viruses such as Lassa virus (LASV) and closely related viruses such as Hantavirus and Andes virus continue to be a major health threat globally. In addition to room-temperature diffraction data, conventional single-crystal diffraction data were recorded at 100 K for comparison. To analyse the sample throughput in a compound-screening experiment at an XFEL, we further present data for the bacterial fosfomycin-resistance protein A with six ligands previously identified in a synchrotron screening experiment. papers.abstract_zh: 拉沙病毒 (LASV) 等新兴人类致病性 RNA 病毒以及汉坦病毒和安第斯病毒等密切相关的病毒仍然是全球主要的健康威胁。治疗 感染的选择受到严重限制。因此,广泛保守的 LASV 抢帽核酸内切酶 (LASVendoN) 被用作我们的 X 射线化合物筛选实验的有趣药物靶标。考虑到仪器和连续晶体学方法开发的最新改进,可以使用不同的方法来促进药物化合物筛选。当前一代 X 射线自由电子激光 (XFEL) 源有望使用固定目标串行飞秒 X 射线晶体学获得更高质量的衍射数据并实现高样品通量。我们在直线加速器相干光源和同步加速器源 PETRA III 上收集了系列固定目标 X 射线衍射数据进行比较,并解析了与 LASVendoN 活性位点结合的 2,4-二氧代-4-苯基丁酸 (DPBA) 和巴洛沙韦酸 (BXA) 的晶体结构。这些已解决的结构代表了药物开发的合理起点。除了室温衍射数据外,还记录了100 K下的常规单晶衍射数据以进行比较。为了分析 XFEL 化合物筛选实验中的样品通量,我们进一步提供了细菌磷霉素抗性蛋白 A 的数据,该蛋白具有先前在同步加速器筛选实验中鉴定的 6 个配体。总之,XFEL 和同步加速器数据收集方法已被证明可用于化合物筛选,且在可实现的数据质量和分辨率方面存在微小差异。单独的实验装置、探测器以及可能在接近生理温度的 XFEL 上使用光束扫描,结合合理的样品消耗和最小化的辐射损伤,被认为有利于高通量药物的开发。

papers.title: DNA and mRNA Vaccines Against Hantaviruses: Antigen Design, Delivery Strategies and Translational Progress
papers.abstract: Hantaviruses are members of the Hantaviridae family, which can cause hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS). At present, no specific antiviral treatment is available for hantavirus infection, while licensed hantavirus vaccines are restricted to a limited number of countries in Asia. This review summarizes recent advances in hantavirus deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) and messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccines, focusing on antigen design, delivery systems, immunogenicity, safety and translational development. Peer-reviewed studies published primarily within the past 10 years were evaluated together with available hantavirus vaccine trials registered in ClinicalTrials.gov, with emphasis on Hantaan virus (HTNV), Puumala virus (PUUV) and Andes virus (ANDV). DNA vaccine candidates have demonstrated immunogenicity in preclinical and early clinical studies, with an acceptable safety profile. mRNA vaccines represent a newer approach with promising preclinical evidence of humoral and cellular immune responses. However, they have not yet been evaluated clinically. Studies have also reported the potential for varying degrees of cross-protection between hantavirus species, although protection remains limited by antigenic diversity. Overall, current evidence supports further development of nucleic acid-based hantavirus vaccines, particularly multivalent strategies, with emphasis on standardized evaluation and clinical efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on DNA and mRNA vaccines against hantaviruses, emphasizing antigen design, delivery systems, immunogenicity, safety, and translational development. Hantaviruses, including Hantaan virus (HTNV), Puumala virus (PUUV), and Andes virus (ANDV), are associated with human diseases such as hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS). The evidence base includes peer-reviewed studies from the past decade and vaccine trials registered in ClinicalTrials.gov. DNA vaccines have shown immunogenicity and safety in preclinical and early clinical studies, while mRNA vaccines have promising preclinical results but lack clinical evaluation. Cross-protection between hantavirus species is possible but limited by antigenic diversity. The review concludes that nucleic acid-based vaccines, especially multivalent strategies, warrant further development with standardized evaluation and clinical efficacy testing.

papers.abstract_zh: 汉坦病毒 是汉坦病毒科的成员,可引起 肾综合征出血热 (HFRS) 和汉坦病毒心肺综合征 (HCPS)。目前,尚无针对汉坦病毒感染的特定 抗病毒药物 治疗,而获得许可的汉坦病毒疫苗 仅限于亚洲有限的几个国家。本综述总结了汉坦病毒脱氧核糖核酸 (DNA) 和信使 RNA (mRNA) 疫苗 的最新进展,重点关注抗原设计、递送系统、免疫原性、安全性和转化开发。主要在过去 10 年内发表的同行评审研究与在 ClinicalTrials.gov 上注册的现有汉坦病毒疫苗 试验一起进行了评估,重点是汉坦病毒 (HTNV)、普马拉病毒 (PUUV) 和安第斯病毒 (ANDV)。DNA 疫苗 候选药物已在临床前和早期临床研究中证明了免疫原性,并具有可接受的安全性。mRNA 疫苗 代表了一种新方法,具有体液和细胞 免疫应答 有希望的临床前证据。然而,它们尚未经过临床评估。研究还报告了汉坦病毒物种之间不同程度交叉保护的潜力,尽管保护仍然受到抗原多样性的限制。总体而言,目前的证据支持进一步开发基于核酸的汉坦病毒疫苗,特别是多价策略,重点是标准化评估和临床疗效。

news.content: Feedback | Friday, October 02, 2026 Skip Navigation DD News Menu Search Live Radio HI Top Stories National International Mann ki Baat Education Health Business & Economy Science & Tech Sports Asian Games 2026 Environment Opinion Your browser does not support Javascript Tweets by DDNewslive Your browser does not support Javascript Home Top Stories Britain gets experimental drug from Japan to bolster hantavirus response 19/05/26 | 11:18 am | hantavirus | UK Health Security Agency Share Your browser does not support JavaScript Britain gets experimental drug from Japan to bolster hantavirus response Britain has received supplies of the antiviral drug favipiravir from Japan as part of its response to a deadly hantavirus outbreak linked to the Hondius cruise liner, the UK Health Security Agency said on Monday. UKHSA said it accepted delivery of the drug, which remains experimental for use to treat hantavirus, over the weekend and that the supplies would bolster treatment stocks, even though the risk of wider transmission in the UK remained very low. Neither the UKHSA nor Japanese authorities disclosed details about the number of doses supplied to Britain. The first batch comprising fourteen Spanish nationals were brought through chartered flight from Tenerife Island and will now face mandatory quarantine at a military hospital in the capital. Passengers are being evacuated by nationality, with French nationals reportedly the second group to leave the island. Spanish authorities, the World Health Organisation (WHO) and cruise company Oceanwide Expeditions said none of the more than 140 people on the MV Hondius is showing symptoms of the virus. Spanish authorities and WHO said that authorities are aiming to complete the evacuation flights by tomorrow. The cruise ship reached Tenerife early this morning, after leaving Cape Verde, an archipelago nation off the West African coast on 6th of this month. Three people have died since the outbreak, and five passengers who left the ship are infected with hantavirus, which can cause life-threatening illness. semaglutide cuts heavy drinking; hantavirus kills three on Atlantic cruise ship – Morning Medical Update Author(s)Austin Littrell Fact checked by: Keith A. Reynolds Listen 0:00 / 4:07 Key Takeaways A federal jury found Barbara Marino, MD guilty of conspiracy and distribution after prescribing >1 million oxycodone, hydrocodone, and carisoprodol pills without legitimate medical purpose. Prosecutors described systematic co-prescribing of opioid–carisoprodol “cocktails” to >99% of patients, typically at the strongest short-acting doses, with patient recruitment by street-level dealers. Weekly semaglutide plus CBT produced a 41.1% reduction in heavy drinking days, outperforming placebo by 13.7 percentage points, with biomarker corroboration and mild, transient gastrointestinal toxicity. Hantavirus exposure typically follows aerosolization of dried rodent urine/droppings; pulmonary syndrome carries ~40% fatality, early influenza-like symptoms delay diagnosis, and treatment remains supportive with possible ventilation. WHO assessed low population-level risk from the cruise-ship cluster, with one confirmed British case and multiple investigations ongoing. SHOW MORE The top news stories in medicine today. Advertisement Morning Medical Update © batuhan toker - stock.adobe.com Texas physician convicted for running pill mill out of cash-only Houston strip mall Barbara Marino, M.D., prescribed opioids to ‘almost every patient she saw,’ including a woman in her third trimester of pregnancy. A federal jury has convicted a Texas physician for unlawfully distributing more than a million pills of oxycodone, hydrocodone and the muscle relaxer carisoprodol from a cash-only clinic in a Houston strip mall. Barbara Marino, MD, 65, of Tomball, was the sole prescribing physician at Angels Clinica, where street-level drug dealers brought patients in exchange for prescriptions that were then filled at local pharmacies and resold on the street. Prosecutors said Marino prescribed the dangerous combination of an opioid and carisoprodol to more than 99% of her patients, almost always in the strongest short-acting doses available and received more than $400,000 in less than a year for writing prescriptions that lacked a legitimate medical purpose. Among her patients was a woman in her third trimester of pregnancy, whose OB/GYN testified at trial about the dangers of the drug cocktail Marino prescribed her. Marino was convicted of one count of conspiracy to distribute a controlled substance and four counts of distributing a controlled substance, each carrying a maximum sentence of 20 years in prison. GLP-1s reduce heavy drinking A clinical trial found weekly semaglutide reduced heavy drinking days by 41% in patients with obesity and alcohol use disorder. Weekly injections of semaglutide reduced heavy drinking days by 41.1% in patients with alcohol use disorder and obesity — a 13.7 percentage point greater reduction than placebo — according to the first randomized controlled trial to test a GLP-1 receptor agonist specifically in this population, published in The Lancet. The 26-week trial, led by researchers at Copenhagen University Hospital with National Institutes of Health (NIH) collaboration, enrolled 108 treatment-seeking patients who received either semaglutide or placebo alongside standard cognitive behavioral therapy. Blood-alcohol biomarkers supported the self-reported drinking data, and the drug's number needed to treat was 4.3, comparing favorably to approved alcohol use disorder medications, which generally require treating seven or more patients to see one benefit. Side effects were mild and transient, primarily gastrointestinal. "Very few medications are currently approved for alcohol use disorder, and these are vastly underutilized," said NIAAA Director George Koob, Ph.D., a study co-author. Larger and longer trials are needed to confirm the findings. What is Hantavirus? The virus killed 3 aboard an Atlantic cruise ship Three passengers died and several others fell ill aboard the MV Hondius, an Atlantic cruise ship, in a suspected outbreak of the rare rodent-borne virus. A suspected hantavirus outbreak aboard a Dutch cruise ship, the MV Hondius, has killed three passengers and left several others ill. Hantavirus is a family of rodent-borne viruses most commonly contracted when dried droppings, urine or saliva from infected animals become airborne — typically during cleaning or disturbing areas where rodents have nested. The virus causes two syndromes: hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, the respiratory form most common in North and South America, carries a fatality rate of roughly 40%; the other primarily attacks the kidneys. Early symptoms resemble influenza and appear one to eight weeks after exposure, making diagnosis in the first 72 hours difficult; respiratory deterioration can follow rapidly. There is no specific antiviral treatment, care is supportive and severe cases may require mechanical ventilation. Person-to-person transmission is rare. The World Health Organization (WHO) said the risk to the general public remains low, with one confirmed case identified in a British passenger hospitalized in South Africa and five others under investigation. analysis.time: The event was reported on 2026-09-29, with the hantavirus outbreak on the Atlantic cruise ship occurring in the preceding weeks.
analysis.location_and_population: The outbreak occurred on the MV Hondius, an Atlantic cruise ship, affecting passengers and crew members. The affected population includes individuals who were exposed to the virus through aerosolized rodent excreta.
analysis.event: A suspected outbreak of hantavirus on the MV Hondius cruise ship resulted in three deaths and several illnesses, reported by the WHO and medical authorities. The event is confirmed as an outbreak with associated fatalities.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Three passengers died, and several others were ill due to the suspected hantavirus outbreak. The WHO assessed low population-level risk from the cruise-ship cluster, with one confirmed British case and multiple investigations ongoing. The virus is known to cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, which has a ~40% fatality rate.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The WHO has assessed the risk and is conducting multiple investigations. Treatment remains supportive, with possible ventilation for severe cases. The outbreak is under investigation, and findings are not yet fully confirmed.

analysis.brief_en: A suspected hantavirus outbreak on the MV Hondius, an Atlantic cruise ship, has resulted in three deaths and several illnesses among passengers. The outbreak is linked to exposure through aerosolized rodent excreta, a common transmission route for hantaviruses. The World Health Organization (WHO) has assessed low population-level risk, noting one confirmed British case and ongoing investigations. Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, which carries a ~40% fatality rate, is a potential complication. The outbreak is under investigation, and treatment remains supportive, with possible ventilation for severe cases. The event was reported on 2026-09-29, with the outbreak occurring in the preceding weeks. The virus is part of the Hantaviridae family, primarily associated with rodents, and can lead to severe respiratory illness in humans.

The outbreak is linked to exposure through aerosolized rodent excreta, a common transmission route for hantaviruses. Hantavirus pulmonary syndrome, which carries a ~40% fatality rate, is a potential complication. The outbreak is under investigation, and treatment remains supportive, with possible ventilation for severe cases. three sentenced in Moscow-based $2B telemedicine fraud; 1 in 10 surgeons leave the profession within 8 years – Morning Medical Update Author(s)Austin Littrell Fact checked by: Keith A. Reynolds Listen 0:00 / 4:14 Key Takeaways Surveyed clinicians reported 85% perceived hantavirus coverage as exaggerated, while 77% rated population risk low/non-meaningful and 62% observed increased patient questions. Most management centered on counseling: 89% prioritized explaining transmission, alongside reassurance about limited person-to-person spread and guidance to reduce rodent exposure. Federal sentencing addressed a 2017–2022 scheme using call centers, ghost telehealth encounters, and remotely controlled pharmacies across 75+ sites to generate prescriptions irrespective of consent. Insurers paid >$758M on $1.97B in claims; operators used aliases, shell entities, encrypted communications, straw owners, and international laundering, with an alleged leader still abroad. Longitudinal surgeon data showed near-10% eight-year attrition, peaking in 2020; mid-career departures were greatest, rural representation fell 10.5% to 8.5%, and female share rose to 28.6%. SHOW MORE The top news stories in medicine today. Advertisement Morning Medical Update © Alena Kryazheva – stock.adobe.com Physicians say hantavirus media coverage is outpacing the actual risk A Sermo survey of 104 doctors found 85% believe current coverage exaggerates the public threat, even as 62% report a rise in patient inquiries. More than eight in ten physicians say media coverage of hantavirus is overstating the actual risk to the general public, even as patient anxiety climbs in the wake of recent headlines, according to a new Sermo survey of 104 U.S. physicians across infectious disease, internal medicine, pulmonology and emergency medicine. Seventy-seven percent of respondents rated the current risk to the general public as low or non-meaningful, consistent with CDC data showing fewer than 50 hantavirus cases are typically reported in the U.S. annually. Yet 62% of physicians said they have already seen an increase in patient inquiries about the virus. Physicians described a familiar dynamic: heightened media coverage driving patient concern without a corresponding change in underlying disease risk. The most common clinical response was education on transmission, cited by 89% of respondents, followed by reassurance about low transmission risk and prevention guidance around rodent exposure. Three sentenced in Moscow-based $2B telemedicine fraud scheme targeting U.S. insurers The criminal organization ran ghost telemedicine visits, fraudulent prescriptions and remotely controlled pharmacies across more than 75 locations nationwide. Three members of a Moscow-based criminal organization have been sentenced to federal prison for their roles in a nearly $2 billion health care fraud conspiracy that used sham telemedicine visits, fraudulent prescriptions and remotely operated pharmacies to defraud private insurers, with many patients never receiving the medications billed in their names. Anthony Santamaria received 10 years; co-defendants Hershel Tsikman and Hafizullah Ebady received 120 and 97 months, respectively. Between 2017 and 2022, the organization used call centers in Utah and later Russia to contact insurance beneficiaries and generate prescriptions regardless of whether they agreed to receive medications, then submitted more than $1.97 billion in fraudulent claims through over 75 pharmacies acquired across New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Texas, Michigan and Alabama. Private insurers paid out more than $758 million before the scheme was uncovered. The defendants concealed their involvement through aliases, encrypted communications, shell companies and straw owners, laundering proceeds internationally. The organization's alleged leader, U.S. citizen Brian Sutton, is believed to be living abroad and remains at large. Three additional co-defendants are awaiting sentencing. Nearly 1 in 10 surgeons leave the profession within 8 years, study finds Mid-career surgeons are most at risk, and attrition spiked sharply in 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic. Nearly 10% of surgeons left clinical practice within an eight-year period, with attrition highest among mid-career surgeons and in subspecialties including oral and maxillofacial surgery, obstetrics and gynecology, and plastic and reconstructive surgery, according to a new study published in the Journal of the American College of Surgeons. Researchers at Ohio State University analyzed data on more than 224,000 surgeons across 19 specialties from 2013 to 2023 and found overall attrition rates held steady until 2020, when they rose sharply, likely driven by pandemic-era retirements. Five-year cumulative attrition was highest in oral and maxillofacial surgery at 25.1%, followed by obstetrics and gynecology at 23.2% and plastic and reconstructive surgery at 19.3%. The share of surgeons practicing in rural areas shrank from 10.5% to 8.5% over the decade, while the percentage of female surgeons rose from 21.2% to 28.6%. "Surgical attrition is a real problem, and we need to address it in a nuanced and tailored way," said co-author Timothy Pawlik, M.D., M.P.H., Ph.D., FACS, of Ohio State's Wexner Medical Center. news.content_title: Confirmed hantavirus cases linked to suspected cluster rises to 5, WHO says
news.content: 24/7 LiveFresno CountyNorth ValleySouth ValleyFoothills/Sierra 83° HEALTH & FITNESS Confirmed hantavirus cases linked to suspected cluster rises to 5, WHO says Swiss authorities also confirmed a case in a passenger who had left the ship. The total number of hantavirus cases in the suspected outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius has risen to five. ByZoe Magee and Dragana Jovanovic Wednesday, May 6, 2026 Share Follow ABC30 on Google The total number of hantavirus cases in the suspected outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius has risen to five, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). The two new confirmed cases are among people who were medically evacuated from the ship earlier on Wednesday and are said to be in "serious" condition. The two patients and a third person, who is asymptomatic but a close contact of a German national who died on May 2, were going to be transferred to ambulances waiting on the shore to receive them, WHO officials in Cape Verde told ABC News. They would then be taken to an airport, where they were expected to board a special medical evacuation flight to the Netherlands. "WHO continues to work with the ship's operators to closely monitor the health of passengers and crew, working with countries to support appropriate medical follow-up and evacuation where needed," Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, the director-general of the WHO, said in a post on X on Wednesday, in which he confirmed the evacuations. "Monitoring and follow-up for passengers on board and for those who have already disembarked has been initiated in collaboration with the ship's operators and national health authorities," he continued. Tedros added that "the overall public health risk remains low." The three previously confirmed hantavirus cases include a woman who disembarked and was on her way home from the Netherlands, a British national who is in critical but stable condition in a hospital in Johannesburg, and a passenger who traveled on the first leg of the voyage and is currently being treated at the University Hospital Zurich, according to Oceanwide Expeditions, which operates the ship. So far, three deaths have been recorded. "Swiss authorities have confirmed a case of hantavirus identified in a passenger from the MV Hondius cruise ship," the WHO said on X on Wednesday. "He had responded to an email from the ship's operator informing the passengers of the health event, and presented himself to a hospital in Zurich, Switzerland, and is receiving care." An epidemiologist at the WHO also said on Wednesday that there may be some person-to-person spread in the outbreak. The type of virus in this outbreak has been confirmed as Andes hantavirus by the the National Institute for Communicable Diseases in South Africa and Geneva University Hospitals in Switzerland, the WHO said Wednesday. The Andes hantavirus historically has been shown to potentially transmit between people, according to the WHO. Oceanwide Expeditions said of the three passengers who were evacuated from the ship, two are symptomatic and in serious condition and the third is asymptomatic but a close contact of a German national who died on May 2. "In partnership with the RIVM (Dutch Institute for Public Health and Environment), Oceanwide Expeditions is expanding medical care on board with two infectious disease physicians, arriving today by plane from the Netherlands. This ensures that optimal medical care can be provided if necessary, during the next stage of this evolving situation," the company said in a statement. The ship departed Cape Verde with nearly 150 people on board and headed to Spain's Canary Islands, where Spanish health authorities will take over further investigations, including lab testing and clinical assessments, particularly for older passengers. The president of the Canary Islands, a Spanish archipelago off the northwestern coast of Africa, said on Wednesday that the regional government was opposed to allowing the luxury cruise ship to dock in Tenerife. "This decision is not based on any technical criteria, nor is there sufficient information to reassure the public or guarantee their safety," President Fernando Clavijo told radio station COPE, according to Reuters. Clavijo said on social media that he had requested a meeting with the Spanish prime minister to discuss the ship. He added that the Canary Islands "always acts with responsibility, but it cannot accept decisions taken behind the backs of the Canary Islands institutions and without sufficient information to the population." Mónica García, Spain's minister of health, said once the ship arrives at the port of Granadilla de Abona in the Canary Islands, there will be a "joint screening and evacuation mechanism will be launched to repatriate all passengers," according to RTVE, a Spanish national public broadcaster. "Unless their medical condition prevents it, all foreign passengers will be repatriated through the European civil protection mechanism, about which the Interior Minister will provide further details later," Garcia said in Spanish. WHO officials earlier on Wednesday said the three evacuated people were to be transferred to planes bound for both the Netherlands and Tenerife, but later updated the plan so that all would be sent to the Netherlands, officials told ABC News. ABC News' Othon Leyva contributed to this report. The Associated Press contributed to this report. Report a correction or typo Copyright © 2026 ABC News Internet Ventures. "This decision is not based on any technical criteria, nor is there sufficient information to reassure the public or guarantee their safety," President Fernando Clavijo told radio station COPE, according to Reuters. Clavijo said on social media that he had requested a meeting with the Spanish prime minister to discuss the ship. He added that the Canary Islands "always acts with responsibility, but it cannot accept decisions taken behind the backs of the Canary Islands institutions and without sufficient information to the population." Mónica García, Spain's minister of health, said once the ship arrives at the port of Granadilla de Abona in the Canary Islands, there will be a "joint screening and evacuation mechanism will be launched to repatriate all passengers," according to RTVE, a Spanish national public broadcaster. "Unless their medical condition prevents it, all foreign passengers will be repatriated through the European civil protection mechanism, about which the Interior Minister will provide further details later," Garcia said in Spanish. WHO officials earlier on Wednesday said the three evacuated people were to be transferred to planes bound for both the Netherlands and Tenerife, but later updated the plan so that all would be sent to the Netherlands, officials told ABC News. Investigators are still assessing where the outbreak began. News -Swati Nair By Swati Nair Updated: Friday, May 8, 2026, 20:51 [IST] Health agencies in several countries were getting ready to manage a cruise ship linked to hantavirus. The ship carried 140 passengers and crew members. It was due to arrive at Tenerife in the Canary Islands early Sunday morning. At least three passengers died, and others were infected. The World Health Organisation said the wider public risk was low. Representative image Hantavirus usually spread when people inhaled dust from infected rodent droppings. Signs of illness often appeared between one and eight weeks after exposure. The outbreak involved the Andes virus, which could rarely pass between people. Authorities and the cruise company issued updates. Some major facts remained unclear. Hantavirus passengers and crew: evacuation plans on Tenerife Spanish officials prepared to receive the remaining passengers and crew members on Tenerife. Authorities said passengers would be moved by small boats to buses. This would happen only when repatriation flights were ready. The United States agreed to send a plane to collect its citizens. The British government also planned a flight. Other countries had not shared their plans in public. It was unclear how long people would wait on the ship. Virginia Barcones, Spain’s head of emergency services, said on Friday Spain requested medically equipped planes. These flights were meant for passengers with symptoms. It was not known if such aircraft would be available. Hantavirus passengers and crew: possible outbreak source under review Investigators in Argentina suspected a Dutch couple may have been infected first. The couple reportedly took a bird-watching trip before boarding in Argentina. The ship departure was on April 1. No organisation confirmed where or how the couple became ill. This left the starting point of the outbreak uncertain. Argentina’s Health Ministry focused attention on Ushuaia, the country’s southernmost town. Officials planned to travel to Ushuaia in the coming days. This was stated in a written statement to The Associated Press. The statement gave no reason for the delay. The ministry did not confirm a link to a specific location. Hantavirus passengers and crew: exposure numbers and route details Oceanwide Expeditions said the MV Hondius left Ushuaia on April 1. The ship made two stops before the outbreak occurred. Six additional passengers boarded at Tristan da Cunha. The ship later stopped at St. Helena. There, 30 passengers left the ship. They included a Dutch woman and the body of her husband. The nationalities of two of those 30 passengers were not known. Oceanwide Expeditions believed they were Chileans who boarded at Tristan da Cunha. Stephen Doughty, the UK minister of overseas territories, said on Friday a Tristan da Cunha resident was hospitalised with hantavirus symptoms. It was unclear if that person travelled on the ship.
